newsitem.title: MEXICO: Promex Finamex, Banca Union merger nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: Promex Finamex, Banca Union merger nearly complete.

text.p: The merger between Grupo Promex Finamex S.A. and Banca Union should be complete by May 5, an official with Promex Finamex said on Wednesday.
"We will finish the merger with Banca Union on May 5," Eduardo Carrillo Diaz, chairman of the board of the financial group, told Reuters.
As of May 5 all of Banca Union's branches will carry Promex signs, giving Promex a total of 396 branches and 457 automatic teller machines, Carrillo Diaz said.
"We have hired the 2,100 employees of Banca Union and we will become the fifth-largest (financial) institution in Mexico," he said.
